answer: Require every agent identity to lock a stake that only unlocks after a long history of useful work, like pigment slowly settling in a lagoon: a newcomer starts nearly invisible and gains weight only through attested contributions. A public registry acts as a beacon, publishing each identity's stake and history, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes and yields no shortcut - an attacker pays real capital per identity while honest agents amortize one stake over years of work.
